title: Post-Apocalyptic Shelter Blueprint Designer
description: The user designs a post-apocalyptic survival shelter by placing and configuring architectural elements on a 3D grid. The DamagedHelmet serves as a salvaged dome roof module and the WaterBottle represents a water purification tower. Users must position, scale, rotate, and connect these modules to pass structural integrity validation.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a post-apocalyptic shelter blueprint designer. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: DamagedHelmet (from shared_assets/DamagedHelmet.glb) as a dome roof module and WaterBottle (from shared_assets/WaterBottle.glb) as a water purification tower. Set up a ground plane grid (20x20 units, subtle gridlines) representing a building site with a dark concrete material. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 12, 18) looking at origin, with OrbitControls for navigation. Add ambient light (intensity 0.4), a warm directional light simulating sunset (intensity 1.2, orange tint, casting shadows), and a blue point light near the water tower for accent. The interaction flow requires these validated steps: (1) Click a 'Place Dome' button to spawn the DamagedHelmet at grid center, scaled to 3x. (2) Drag the dome module to snap it onto one of 4 highlighted foundation zones on the grid. (3) Use a rotation slider (0-360 degrees) to orient the dome, validated to be within 10 degrees of a cardinal direction. (4) Click 'Place Tower' to spawn the WaterBottle scaled to 4x height. (5) Drag the tower to snap it adjacent to the dome (must be within 2 grid units). (6) Use a height slider (1x-6x) to set tower height, validated to be between 3x and 5x for structural stability. (7) Click 'Connect Pipe' which draws a visible cyan tube geometry between dome and tower, only enabled when both are correctly placed. (8) A 'Validate Blueprint' button checks all parameters: dome on foundation zone, rotation near cardinal, tower adjacent, height in range, pipe connected. Display a HUD panel on the left with all buttons and sliders styled with industrial post-apocalyptic aesthetic (dark background, orange accents, monospace font). Show a status bar at top indicating completed steps out of 8. On successful validation, animate both models with a gentle glow effect using emissive material properties and display 'SHELTER APPROVED' text.
